mutants.name: at_least_four
mutants.desc: heuristic: free cells come in rectangles of size >= 4, so possible iff n*n - k == 0 or n*n - k >= 4

mutants.name: block_bound_off_by_one
mutants.desc: ref-style DP over (rows, cols) used, but the block size loops are range(2, a) (exclusive), so a block can't use all remaining rows/cols

mutants.name: rows_only_budget
mutants.desc: sum of r_i x c_i blocks with sum r_i <= n but each c_i only bounded by n (column budget not shared)

mutants.name: single_block
mutants.desc: non-fixed cells form a single r x c block (2 <= r, c <= n): k fixed iff k == n*n or n*n - k == r*c

mutants.name: square_blocks
mutants.desc: assumes the non-fixed blocks are square (r == c): sums of r^2 with total r <= n
